notes: Creator walkthrough picks applied on 2026-10-15 to the live revised crew output, then the creator's story-beat order applied on 2026-10-16. Creator still approves voice and lore before recording.

DANIEL.name: Daniel
DANIEL.role: Young sailor, shelters in the basement

steps.title: Arrive and feed the boiler
steps.location: Outside the lighthouse door, the hall, the basement engine room
steps.player_action: Wait outside until Ted opens the door, step into the lighthouse, then go down to the basement and shovel coal into the boiler until the gauge reaches working pressure.

steps.title: Let the sailors in
steps.location: Lighthouse window, the path from the dock, the island gate
steps.player_action: Notice the moored rowboat, go down the path and open the island gate for the stranded sailors Arthur and Daniel. Daniel goes down to the basement and stays there.

steps.title: Fetch a new burner
steps.location: Lantern room, hall, dock, steam launch, the Saltgate quays
steps.player_action: Follow Ted up to the lantern room, where he finds the burner broken; then board the steam launch with Arthur, cross the Gullwater and pick up the replacement burner at the Saltgate quays.

steps.title: Fit the burner
steps.location: Lighthouse dock, hall, tower stairs, lamp room
steps.player_action: Carry the burner up the tower and fit it into the arc lamp, with Ted waiting in the lamp room.

steps.title: Resolution
steps.player_action: Watch the ship pass the rocks safely (win) or run aground (fail).

Player reaches the launch at the dock.

Outbound crossing begins (untimed steering practice).

Boat docks at the Saltgate quays.

Existing crew event. Hands over to ARTHUR_RET_* calls.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Hrmph. You're the new guy, then. Storm season, and they send me a new money toff. In.
lines.subtitle: TED: Hrmph. You're the new guy, then. Storm season, and they send me a new money toff. In.

lines.staging: Isaac stands outside the lighthouse door in the wind; Ted opens it and looks him over.

lines.text: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.
lines.subtitle: TED: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.

lines.text: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please?

lines.text: That ship...we didn't get the burner out in time...those poor souls on board...we've failed...FAILED!!

journal.text: Ted has let me in. The beacon is starved: shovel coal into the boiler in the basement engine room until the gauge climbs.
A rowboat is moored at the dock. Open the island gate and let the stranded sailors in.
Ted found the beacon's burner cracked. Cross the Gullwater with Arthur, fetch the replacement burner from the Saltgate quays, and bring it back.
